latest_release.body:
# Coopanion v0.2.24

**Coo 可以变淡，开着鼠标穿透时按住一个键就能点到 Coo;气泡折行时收窄到各行等长，关闭按钮移到气泡外**

## 新功能

- **Coo 可以变淡**:「习惯 → 显示」的「透明度」可以设 0–95%,也可以把「透明度」加进悬停按钮，在 Coo 头顶拖滑条调。变淡的只有 Coo 的形象，气泡、悬停按钮和右键菜单不变淡。Windows 上「全屏时」一行多了「变淡」:前台窗口全屏铺满 Coo 所在的屏时，改用这一行设的透明度(默认 40%),退出全屏后恢复(感谢 @kwk1001、@allisera,#778)。
- **鼠标穿透时按住一个键点到 Coo**:「习惯 → 行为与互动」新增「暂停穿透键」,默认关闭，打开后默认按住右 Ctrl。鼠标穿透开着时(托盘菜单里启用的和全屏时自动的都算),按住这个键 Coo 照常接收点击，松开后恢复穿透;和别的键一起按(比如用 Ctrl 按快捷键)时不算。悬停按钮里可以加「鼠标穿透」,和托盘菜单的「启用鼠标穿透」是同一个开关(感谢 @kwk1001、@allisera,#778)。
- **悬停按钮「电脑操作」**:悬停按钮和右键菜单里可以加「电脑操作」,按钮显示电脑操作开着还是关着，确认过风险说明后点击直接开关。风险说明在把它加进悬停按钮、或第一次打开电脑操作时出现;确认记录改为存在配置里，更新前确认过的会再看到一次(感谢 @kwk1001、@diyvnqianli,#790)。
- **动态效果分档**:「习惯 → 显示」的「动态效果」可选低、中、高或跟随系统(默认)。中档去掉回弹和装饰性的动画，低档只保留颜色变化和表示正在进行的指示(转圈、进度条、思考点);设置窗口、桌宠窗口和装扮页一起改变，Coo 的走动不受影响。跟随系统时和更新前一样：系统要求减少动态效果时为低，否则为高(感谢 @kwk1001)。
- **气泡**:一句话折行时，气泡收窄到各行等长，不再偏向一边;提问、确认、对话和输入框的 × 移到气泡外右侧;输入框里的文字超过一行后占满整个输入框，滚动条在气泡外;自动档的输入气泡在 Coo 的回复写完 0.5 秒后先淡出;尾巴的线和边框一样粗，不再压到圆角。「习惯」页里气泡相关的设置归到「气泡」一节，末尾的示例框可以播放一轮对话，拖动气泡尺寸、字体尺寸时示例跟着变(感谢 @kwk1001)。
- **只投递录音时不等识别**:「语音输入」页关掉「投递转写」、只投递录音时，录音收完就发给模型，不再等识别出文字;识别出的文字随后显示在气泡和对话页。识别服务可以单独停止，重启后保持停止;停止后仍可以只投递录音给开了多模态的 Gemini 协议端点和豆包端点(感谢 @ThermalEng)。
- **World 的环境提示词页**:高级模式里 World 的环境提示词页有了和系统提示词页一样的工具栏：撤销、撤销全部改动、保存，Core 支持时还有「清空对话并重开」「立即应用」。两页有没保存的修改时离开，改用窗口自己的确认框，写明哪一栏没保存(感谢 @kwk1001)。
- **用量页「按 World」**:「用量与成本」页的分组明细多了「按 World」一档，按 World 列出调用、token 和费用。Coo 主对话的每次请求按这次新进上下文的内容分摊：送来的事件算给来源 World,工具结果算给工具所属的 World,调用某个 World 工具的那部分输出算给那个 World,其余输出按同样的比例分;World 自己调用模型的用量全部算给它。Persona 加的内容(如轮数提示)、Persona 自己工具的结果和不来自 World 的事件记作「未归属」,排在末行。各行加起来等于总计;一次请求分给几个 World 时，每个 World 的「调用」都算这一次。这一版之前记下的用量都算未归属，已经删掉的 World 只显示 id(感谢 @leafliber,Pal-AI-Lab/Cortico#447)。

## 修复

- **改了屏幕缩放后 Coo 悬在半空**(Windows):运行中修改 Coo 所在那块屏的缩放后，桌宠窗口按新的缩放重新铺满这块屏(感谢 @Unnori,#787)。
- **「DeepSeek（峰谷计价）」实例重启后变成 Coo Pet Provider**:启动时不再改写任何实例的类型。已经被改掉的不会自动改回：退出 Coopanion,把数据目录里 `home/providers/<实例名>/config.json` 的 `"kind": "coo"` 改回 `"kind": "deepseek"`;或者删掉这个实例，用「DeepSeek（峰谷计价）」新建(感谢 @kwk1001、@DTMosken,#800)。
- **重启后设置窗口的配色被改掉**:启动和切换应用语言时不再按 Coo 当前的形象改配色，保留上次选的那套;选中那套的形象包还没加载时也保留(感谢 @kwk1001、@chloveln,#817)。
- **超出字数上限的输入被截掉**:超出上限时文字留在输入框里，字数变红，不能发送，不再截掉多出的部分后发出。对话页上限 4000 字，气泡里的打字框 500 字，打字框超出时可以到对话页接着写(感谢 @kwk1001、@L12275,#779)。
- **Core 重启后设置窗口还是重启前的页面**:Core 在同一端口重启后，设置窗口重新载入，扩展面板按新的扩展清单加载;页面里有没保存的编辑时不重新载入，编辑保留(感谢 @leafliber、@Liufeng123456,#823)。
- **把 Coo 拖过两块屏的交界时闪一下**:不再在另一块屏的边缘闪一两帧(感谢 @kwk1001)。
- **开局引导的台词被鼠标停住**:引导里不用回答的那几句不再因为鼠标停在气泡上而停留，读完就收起;Coo 平时说话的气泡照旧会被鼠标停住。
- **左右不对称的形象走不到屏幕边**:形象包写了左右不同的伸出范围(尾巴、翅膀、单侧武器)时，窄的一侧现在能贴到屏幕边;在屏幕边转身时会往里挪一点(感谢 @kwk1001)。
- **设置窗口**:用量页选长时间范围和细粒度时不再卡住，柱子超过 4320 根的粒度不能选，切换粒度、拆分、排序或自动刷新时滚动位置不再跳动;拖动「World 扩展」排序时落点正确;扩展详情的介绍和评论各自滚动，很长的评论折叠，可以展开;扩展市场侧栏的标签只在词间换行;窄窗口下「World 扩展」的卡片和扩展市场的工具栏不再错位;选中的供应商卡片悬停时描边不再被切;搜索框的 × 悬停显示手型(感谢 @kwk1001)。

## 改动

- **上下文里的附件每次请求都发**:图片、录音和文档留在上下文里时，每次请求都照发，到交接为止;原来每送达一批，更早的附件只剩一行文字，Coo 看不到上一条消息里的图和上一步的截图。长时间电脑操作时单次请求的输入比原来大，较早的部分按缓存价计;用 Gemini / 豆包时，语音的录音也每次重发。附件让请求被模型服务拒收时，去掉这次带的全部附件重发一次，之后的请求不再带它们。
- **新建的 Gemini 端点默认「思考 · 快」**:首次安装和连接向导新建的 Gemini 端点，思考强度从「思考 · 标准」改为「思考 · 快」;已有的端点不变。
- **Windows 安装包**:安装和更新时，新版本的文件先解压并逐个校验，再替换旧文件，中途失败放回旧版本;安装被打断(断电、进程被结束)后，在同一目录再运行一次完整安装包即可恢复。安装错误写在安装目录的 `data\logs\installer.log`;选了「下次再说」、退出时更新失败的，下次启动会提示失败的版本和日志位置。手动运行安装包时，正在运行的 Coopanion 会被请求退出;从 0.2.23 或更早的版本手动覆盖时，请先从托盘菜单退出 Coopanion。新安装默认装到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Coopanion`(加 `/S` 静默安装仍是 `%USERPROFILE%\Coopanion`),已经装好的更新后仍在原来的目录(感谢 @leafliber)。
- **按钮和滑条**:悬停按钮、右键菜单、表盘和滑条的底色改为 90% 不透明，加了淡光泽和阴影;关着的开关按钮改为灰底、略透明。大小和透明度滑条钉住后，鼠标经过别的按钮不会换掉它;滑条或表盘正在用时，Coo 要说的话和提问先排着，用完再出(感谢 @kwk1001)。
- **窗口的页面进程退出时写进日志**:设置窗口、桌宠窗口和装扮窗口的页面进程退出时，运行日志记下原因和退出码;桌宠窗口的页面进程退出后，不再一直给它发光标位置(感谢 @kwk1001)。
- **cortico 子模块升到 v0.2.18**:交接后紧接着的一批很长(比如几十步带截图的电脑操作)时，不再被判成交接没压下上下文而停止提醒和交接，上下文不再一路涨到模型上限(感谢 @chloveln,#713);Windows 上保存配色或头像时，文件被杀毒软件、索引或同步盘占着导致改名失败，原来的配色和头像保留，下次启动不再回到默认(感谢 @kwk1001、@chloveln,#817);高级模式「运行诊断」页的事件表按很少出现的来源筛选时，查询读旧事件期间 Coo 和设置窗口不再卡住(感谢 @jcs130)。
- **Minecraft World 0.2.18**:在扩展市场或扩展详情里把 Minecraft World 更新到 0.2.18、重启进程后,C

Website ｜ Install ｜ Getting Started ｜ Everyday Use ｜ Cost and Privacy ｜ FAQ ｜ Community ｜ Changelog ｜ Development

Coopanion is a desktop pet named Coo that lives on the bottom edge of your screen. It wanders along the edge, chats with you in speech bubbles and listens while you hold the talk key. If you let it, it can also look at your screen, click and type to use the computer for you. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. The interface comes in 11 languages: 简体中文, 繁體中文, English, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español (Latinoamérica), Português (Brasil), Italiano and Русский. On first start it follows the system language, falling back to English, and you can change it later under **Language** on the Habits page. Coo talks to you in the same language. Translations other than Simplified Chinese and English are machine-made; PRs that fix them are welcome.

## Features - Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, Zhipu GLM, Doubao, Baidu Qianfan and StepFun: pick one and paste an API key. You can also sign in with a ChatGPT account and use its ChatGPT plan. - Hold the talk key and speak, or type. Coo answers in a bubble. Speech is recognized on your machine by default, or by a transcription service you set up. - Coo remembers you. What it knows about you is written to `PARTNER.md`, and longer memories are organized by topic and date. When Git is available, every change Coo makes to its text keeps a history; Windows ships with Git, macOS and Linux use the one installed on the system. - With your permission, Coo can look at the screen, click, type and switch windows. This is off by default and you decide when it asks first. It pauses as soon as you touch the mouse or keyboard, and talking with the talk key interrupts it. - An icon over Coo's head shows when it is thinking, reading files, searching, writing or using the computer. - Pick Coo or **DeepSeek Chan**, an animated whale girl with eight vendor color schemes and three outfits. Other figure packs are imported on the Dress up page; see the [figure pack compatibility promise](packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet/README.md#形象包兼容承诺). - Coo comes in several colors, including Nai Coo and five Cultist Simulator principles, and can wear a hat, animal ears or a halo, headphones, an earring or a bow, glasses and neckwear. The size of the pet, its bubbles and the text can each be adjusted. - Ask Coo to remind you at a time of day or in a few minutes, and it sets an alarm. - Install Worlds such as a QQ bot, a drawing room and small games from **World extensions → Extension market**. - Export Coo and its bubbles as an OBS Browser source with a transparent background, to put it on a stream. What changed in each version is in [Releases](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases). ## Install You need: - Windows 10 or 11 (x64), Windows 11 (Arm64), macOS 13 or later (Apple silicon or Intel), or a 64-bit Linux desktop (X11; in a Wayland session it runs through XWayland, with the limits under [Linux](#linux); speech recognition needs glibc 2.32 or later, which means Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 or newer); - an API key from one model service, billed by usage (see [Cost and privacy](#cost-and-privacy)), or a ChatGPT account with a plan. Every release page has a `SHA256SUMS.txt` for checking the downloads. ### Windows - **Installer**: download `Coopanion-Setup-.exe` from the [latest release](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest) and run it. On a PC with an Arm processor, download `Coopanion-Setup--arm64.exe`. The installer is not code-signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info** → **Run anyway**. It installs to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Coopanion` by default, and the program and its data both live in that folder. Don't install it into Program Files or another folder that needs administrator rights: Coopanion can't write its data there and quits with an error. Launch it from the desktop shortcut. If the installer could not create the shortcut, open `Coopanion.exe` in the install folder. - **One command**: in PowerShell, run ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/main/installer/install.ps1 | iex ``` The script downloads the installer for your processor. If antivirus software blocks the graphical installer, the script keeps the downloaded installer and prints its path. Run the downloaded installer with `/S` for a silent install, or add Coopanion to your antivirus's allowed list and try again. A fresh silent install defaults to `%USERPROFILE%\Coopanion`. - **Portable**: download `Coopanion--win-x64-portable.zip` (`…-win-arm64-portable.zip` for an Arm processor) from the [latest release](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest), unpack it anywhere and run `Coopanion.exe`. Its data is kept in the folder's `data`. Copy the whole folder and you have a second Coo with its own memory and settings; up to 5 can run at once, installed and portable together. The portable version does not update itself: unpack the new version into a new folder and copy the old `data` over. ### macOS 1. From the [latest release](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest), download `Coopanion--mac-arm64.dmg` (Apple silicon) or `…-mac-x64.dmg` (Intel), open it and drag Coopanion into Applications. 2. The app is neither signed with an Apple developer ID nor notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open it once and click **Done** on the warning, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security, click **Open Anyway** and enter your password. 3. Coopanion's icon is in the menu bar. It shows up in the Dock only while the settings window is open. While the App Store is in front, Coo drops behind other windows so it doesn't cover the Touch ID prompt for purchases. > [!NOTE] > macOS asks for Microphone (voice input), Input Monitoring (talk key), Screen & System Audio Recording and Accessibility (computer use) the first time each one is needed, and switching apps during computer use also asks to control "System Events". Restart Coopanion after changing Screen Recording, Input Monitoring or Accessibility. macOS does not carry these permissions over to an updated version: if a switch is on but Coopanion says the permission is missing, remove Coopanion from that list with −, add `/Applications/Coopanion.app` back and restart. ### Linux 1. From the [latest release](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest), download `Coopanion--linux-x64.deb` (Debian / Ubuntu) or `Coopanion--linux-x64.AppImage` (other distributions). 2. deb: `sudo apt install ./Coopanion--linux-x64.deb`. AppImage: install your distribution's FUSE 2 compatibility library, run `chmod +x Coopanion-*.AppImage`, then start it. > [!NOTE] > The pet is a transparent always-on-top window, so the desktop needs compositing (on by default in GNOME and KDE). The tray icon needs status icon support (GNOME needs the AppIndicator extension); without a tray you can still right-click Coo to open the settings. Computer use needs `xdotool` and `zenity`, which the deb pulls in; under Wayland, screenshots also need one of `grim`, `spectacle`, `scrot` or ImageMagick. > > In a Wayland session Coopanion runs through XWayland, which sees the cursor only over X11 windows. While the cursor is over the desktop or a native Wayland window, Coo's eyes do not follow it, and the hover buttons show only once the cursor moves onto Coo. ## Getting started 1. **Start**: Coo drops to the bottom of the screen and an icon appears in the tray (the menu bar on Mac, the status bar on Linux). No window opens. 2. **Follow the guide**: in its bubbles, Coo asks for the interface language, what it should call you, where you heard about it (you can skip this), what Coo is like, how often it walks around, which touches it should answer and which model service to use. If a local speech model is missing, the guide offers to download FunASR (about 230 MiB), or Whisper (about 360 MiB) for French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian or Russian. It tries ModelScope first and then Hugging Face. You can skip the download and still choose which buttons appear when you hover over Coo. **Back** at the top left of the bubble returns to the step before, with your earlier answer in place. The × ends the guide, and **Guide** on the Start page runs it again. To change Coo's personality or the way it talks afterwards, just tell it; it writes the persona into its prompt itself. 3. **Say hello**: tap **Left Alt** (**Left Option** on Mac), then press and hold it, say "hello", and let go to send. Allow microphone access when asked.

app's [vendor table](packages/cortico-provider-coo/src/vendors.ts). To use another model, change the Model field on the Start page; for computer use the model has to accept images. Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax and Zhipu GLM each have a mainland China and an international platform with separate accounts and keys. A new connection uses the mainland platform when the interface language is Simplified Chinese and the international one otherwise; switch on the Start page. Doubao, Baidu Qianfan, StepFun and StepFun Step Plan only take mainland China accounts. We have only tested DeepSeek, Anthropic and StepFun Step Plan with real keys, so please open an issue if another one fails. **ChatGPT** needs no key: choose it, press **Continue with ChatGPT** and sign in in the browser that opens. Coo then uses that account's ChatGPT plan. When the plan's usage limit is reached, Coo goes quiet and tries again every 5 minutes.
## Everyday use ### Talking and playing - **Talk**: tap **Left Alt** (**Left Option** on Mac), then hold it and speak; let go to send. The talk key, microphone, speech threshold and listening mode (**While the talk key is held**, **The talk key switches it on and off**, **All the time**) are on the Voice input page. With the system default microphone selected, Coo switches along when you change the system's default input device. If the chosen microphone is unplugged or can't be found, Coo listens through the system default input and switches back when it returns. Voice input uses echo cancellation and noise suppression but not automatic gain control, so Coo leaves the system's microphone volume alone; if your voice comes through too quiet, raise the input volume in the system settings. - **Type** on the Chat page or click the bubble button beside Coo to open the typing box. Enable **Habits → Typing key** to open the box from any window (double-press Left Ctrl by default). A message can contain up to 500 characters and four pasted images in the box, or 4,000 characters and eight images on the Chat page. Over-limit text stays in the draft. Choose **Continue on the Chat page** to move the text and images there if the draft fits its limit. - **Chat page**: after you scroll up to earlier messages, **↓ Back to bottom** appears above the input; click it to return to the latest message. - **Changing keys**: the talk key and the typing key can each be another key, a key combination or a mouse side button, pressed one to three times. When both use the same key, a quick double tap opens the typing box; holding the last press for more than 300 ms starts listening instead and does not open the box. What you say during those 300 ms is kept; with **Open the microphone only while held** on, the microphone opens only at that point, so wait for the listening bubble before speaking. The click-through pause key holds Right Ctrl by default. Set to the talk key's key (say, a tap of Left Alt and then a hold to talk, and a hold of Left Alt to pause), tapping first only listens and a plain hold only pauses click-through. **Habits** says so when the pause key is pressed exactly as the talk key. - **Bubbles**: move the pointer into an open speech bubble to keep it open until the pointer leaves; the opening guide keeps its own timing. Click what Coo is saying to skip the rest of that line. Coo plays a chime when it asks you to confirm something, such as using your computer; clear **Alerts** under **Habits → Sounds** to silence it. Activity bubbles, input bubbles, bubble and text size, and how fast the text appears are under **Habits → Bubbles**, where **Play sample** plays one exchange with the current settings. So is how long speech and input bubbles stay: **Auto**, or **Fixed** at 1–60 seconds, counted from when a speech bubble has typed out or an input bubble was sent or recognized; a question or guide card waiting behind a speech bubble ends a fixed hold at the Auto time. - **Alarms**: the alarms Coo has set are listed under **Alarms** on the App notifications page, where you can delete them; Coo is told when you do. Daily alarms keep ringing at the same local time across daylight-saving changes. Alarms missed while the app was closed go off the next time it starts. - **Holidays**: on Christmas Day and on January 1, 2027, Coo learns it is a holiday when it first appears on your desktop that day, or at midnight if it is already there. When it learns of the New Year, Coo can light fireworks behind itself that spell out 2027, once. - **Touch**: click to poke Coo, rub back and forth over its head to pat it, or drag to pick it up. Let go mid-swing to throw it; drop it on another display and it stays there. **Habits → Response mode** decides which touches Coo answers right away. Speech is recognized locally by default: FunASR for Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean, Whisper for French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Russian, and on Windows you can also use the system recognizer. You can switch to an **OpenAI-compatible** transcription service on the Voice input page instead; each sentence you say is then sent to that service as audio. When the current model takes audio (for example, a Gemini or Doubao connection with multimodal input enabled), each batch of speech goes to the model with its recording along with the recognized text. On the Voice input page you can turn off **Send the recording**, or turn off **Send the transcript** to send the recording without waiting for recognition. The recognition service can be stopped on its own and stays stopped after a restart; while it runs, the recognized text then shows in the bubble beside Coo and on the Chat page. A batch longer than **Recording limit** (5 minutes by default), or sent to a model that does not take audio, falls back to text when recognition is available. ### Pet menus and click-through Rest the pointer on Coo to see your hover buttons. Choose up to six in the guide or under **Habits → Behavior**. The choices are typing, voice input, walking, night mode, sounds, hide, click-through, size, transparency, dress up, computer use and My Worlds. Right-click Coo for the same actions plus settings, pause / resume and quit. Hover over **Dress up** to see your favourite looks, then scroll or click to switch. Hover over **Size** or **Transparency** to open its slider. Drag the slider or scroll over its button to adjust it. Click the button to pin the slider while you move across the other buttons. Click it again or click elsewhere to close it. When you resize Coo or switch looks, the button stays under the pointer until you move away. Speech and questions wait while you use these controls. Confirmations appear immediately, and the thinking bubble appears once the controls close. **Habits → Display** also lets you set the figure’s transparency from 0 to 95%. Bubbles and controls keep their usual opacity. On Windows, enable **Full screen → Fade** there to use a separate value (40% by default) while the foreground window fills Coo’s display. The **Computer use** button shows whether Coo can use your computer. In **Habits**, adding this button or turning on computer use for the first time asks you to confirm the risks. After you confirm, the button switches computer use on or off directly. Until then, clicking it while computer use is off opens the setting. The tray menu (the menu bar icon on Mac) lets you show or hide Coo, toggle click-through, restart or quit. Closing the settings window leaves Coo running. **Start at login** is under **Habits → General**. With click-through on, clicks reach the window beneath Coo while it walks and talks. The **Click-through** hover button and the tray menu toggle the same setting for the current run. To click Coo temporarily, enable **Habits → Behavior → Click-through pause key** and hold the configured key on its own (Right Ctrl by default). Coo keeps taking clicks while a menu, look wheel, pinned slider, typing box, question or confirmation is open, or until you finish a drag. ### Appearance and sound Change the figure, colors and accessories on the **Dress up** page, including the accessories' main and accent colors; changes apply right away. Figure packs can be imported from a zip or a folder, or dragged onto the page, and imported packs are uninstalled there too. Import, replacement and uninstall confirmations, progress and errors use the settings window’s shared dialogs. **Size**, under the figures, sets how large Coo is on the desktop; each figure keeps its own size and gets it back when you switch to it again. The previews on **Dress up** and **Start** keep one size. The star at the top right of the preview adds the look Coo wears to **Favourite looks**, listed in one row at the top of the page: click one to put it on, drag it to reorder, or rename and delete it. A favourite keeps the size it was saved at and puts it back on with the look; its picture is drawn at that size, with the percentage in its corner. After you pick a favourite and change it, its size included, a save button next to the star writes the change back to it. You can also just ask Coo to change its look. By default it changes its figure, colors, walking and snoring on its own, and asks you first before changing sizes, sounds, night mode or names; **Habits → Self-adjustment** loosens or tightens this. Asked what it looks like right now, Coo can take a picture of its body as it is on the desktop at that moment, without bubbles or the desktop behind it; while the pet is hidden there is none to take.

Under **Habits → Sounds** you can choose which sounds play, set the volume for all of the pet's sounds, and let the sound pan left or right with Coo's position on the screen. **Speech → Read bubbles aloud** makes Coo babble short syllables as the text appears, instead of the usual talking sound; pitch and speed are adjustable. These settings only cover the pet's own sounds. Sounds from other Worlds are set on their own pages.

To show Coo in OBS, turn on **Habits → Other → Export OBS overlay**, add the URL it shows as an OBS Browser source and set the width and height to your screen resolution. The source contains only Coo and its bubbles, on a transparent background. ### Computer use Computer use is off by default. Turn on **Let Coo use this computer** under **Habits → Computer use** and confirm the risk notice. If you only want Coo to see the screen and keep its hands off the mouse and keyboard, turn off **Allow the mouse and keyboard**. There are four settings for when Coo asks you first: | When to ask you | When Coo asks | | --- | --- | | Every turn | Before the first screenshot or mouse/keyboard action in each turn | | Before acting | Screenshots without asking; before the first mouse or keyboard action in each turn | | Once (default) | Screenshots without asking; once before acting, then not again for the consent period (30 minutes by default) | | Never | Never | - Coo asks in a bubble, or in a system dialog while the pet is hidden. - Before typing into a terminal or pressing Win+R, Coo asks separately, and that consent also lasts for the consent period. To skip this question, turn it off in advanced mode under **Desktop pet → Config**. - Only what you say, type or choose on the desktop pet's side can make Coo act. When another World asks it to use the computer, Coo checks with you in a bubble first. - Coo can hold keys down for up to 30 seconds, without pausing for your mouse or keyboard meanwhile, and keep a mouse button down across several steps. Whatever it still holds down is released when its turn ends. - As soon as you move the mouse or use the keyboard, Coo pauses and waits until you have been idle for two seconds (by default); if you keep going for 15 seconds, it gives up on that step. It also holds off while you are typing to it. - Anything you say with the talk key interrupts Coo once it is delivered: the reply being written and the steps not yet started are dropped, while a click, drag or key sequence already under way finishes first and a held key is released at once. When it listens **All the time**, what Coo hears does not interrupt it. Pressing the talk key stops **Read bubbles aloud** at once, and lines that appear before you let go stay silent. - Do logins, passwords and payments yourself. One wake allows 40 model requests by default; when Coo hits that limit it stops, and you can tell it to keep going. The limit is **Requests per wake-up** in advanced mode. ### Settings window Open the settings window from the tray icon or from Coo's right-click menu. | Page | What's there | | --- | --- | | Start | Model connection, showing or hiding the pet, interface colors, the first-run guide | | Habits | Language and names, automatic updates, usage statistics, walking and touch responses, which settings Coo may change itself, shortcuts, display (including motion), sound, computer use, OBS overlay | | Dress up | Figure, colors and accessories; import or uninstall figure packs | | Voice input | Recognition engine or transcription service, model download, talk key, microphone, listening mode, speech threshold | | System prompt | Persona and prompt templates; Ctrl+S saves, and **Apply now** puts the new prompt into the current conversation | | Usage & cost | Calls, tokens and spending over time, with breakdowns by purpose, model, model connection and World | | Chat | Conversation history, typing, images | | World extensions | Installed Worlds, groups and order, the extension market | In **Usage & cost → By World**, a shared request’s tokens and cost are split among its sources. Each participating World counts one call. Usage without a World source appears under **Unattributed**. **Motion** under Habits → Display sets how much the settings window and the pet animate, both at once: High keeps everything; Medium drops bounces and decorative flourishes, and lists that reorder fade instead of sliding; Low keeps only colour changes and the signs that something is under way (spinners, progress bars, thinking dots), and everything else lands at once. It follows the system's reduce-motion setting by default: Low when the system asks for less motion, High otherwise. Coo's own walking is not affected. Pause / resume and the switch to **Advanced mode** are at the bottom of the sidebar. Advanced mode adds the **Model connections**, Persona, Memory, **Console** and **Diagnostics** pages. Model connections is where you change models, adjust reasoning effort, add other compatible services, enter prices for services without built-in ones and install provider extensions. Settings show operation errors beside the initiating control. If that control is no longer visible, the error uses a bottom notification. Read failures stay in the affected content region; refresh failures preserve loaded data and edits until a successful retry. Diagnostics report connection, event and log failures separately. Saving an avatar or name, pausing Coo and cancelling an alarm use the updated state as confirmation. ### World extensions In **World extensions → Extension market** you can search for Worlds, filter by category or tag, and install one with **Add to My Worlds** on its card, or open its details first. Packages in the [official index](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/cortico-extensions) also show tags, votes and comments; commenting needs a GitHub sign-in. Caution tags can be excluded; packages with an excluded tag stay out of the results, and the exclusion is remembered next time. A newly installed extension shows up under **Applies on restart**; click **Restart process** to load it. In **My Worlds** you can: - group Worlds and drag them into order, and the sidebar follows the same order; - click a World's name or avatar to see its details and open its configuration; - hide a World from the sidebar, keep it running but hide its tools and messages from Coo, or stop, restart or delete it. On a World's settings page, click the circled **i** beside its title to open the extension details. A running World can't be deleted; stop it first. A deleted World stays under **Applies on restart**, marked in red, until you restart the process.

Provider extensions are under **Advanced mode → Model connections → Extension market**; one that a connection still uses can't be deleted until you delete that connection. Installed extensions live in the data folder and survive a reinstall of the app. If you quit the app while an extension is being installed or uninstalled, it waits for that install or uninstall to finish before quitting. ### Updates The Windows installer build and the AppImage download new versions in the background, and Coo asks whether to restart and update when one is ready. Choose **Later** and it installs when you quit. To stop automatic updates, turn off **Habits → General → Automatic updates**: Coopanion then stops checking and downloading, and an update that was already downloaded is not installed. On Windows, the installer verifies the new files before replacing the current version. If installation is interrupted, run the full installer again in the same folder to recover. Installation errors are recorded in `data\logs\installer.log`. If an update fails during quit after you choose **Later**, Coopanion shows the failed version and the log location the next time it starts. The Mac version, the deb and the Windows portable version do not update themselves. When a new version is out, a download link appears in the settings window's title bar; download it and install it yourself. ## Cost and privacy - **Cost**: Coopanion is free. The model service you choose bills you for usage, which you can see on the Usage & cost page. DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini's paid tier and xAI have built-in prices, and amounts can be shown in another currency at the current exchange rate (or a built-in rate when it can't be fetched). When you sign in with ChatGPT, usage counts toward the plan and no cost is shown. - **Model requests** send your messages, attached images, interactions with Coo and screenshots taken during computer use to the model service you configure. With multimodal input enabled, Coo Pet Provider includes supported attachments in each request while they remain in context. This can resend earlier screenshots and recordings. If the service rejects the attachments, the provider retries once without them. - **Local data** includes API keys, ChatGPT sign-in data, memory, chat history, settings and logs. Speech recognition runs locally by default. If you select a transcription service, it receives the audio for each sentence. With **Voice input → Send the recording** on, recordings sent to an audio-capable model are also saved in the local data folder. - **Anonymous usage statistics**: sent to `survey.palailab.org`. They contain the app version, an outline of the system and hardware, which model service and model you use, which extensions are installed, how often and how long you use the app, settings, where in the program a crash happened, and a randomly generated install ID; no conversations, screenshots, keys, error messages or files. Every field is listed in [docs/TELEMETRY.md](docs/TELEMETRY.md). Turn them off under **Habits → General → Usage statistics**. - **Other network access**: checking GitHub for new versions (the Windows installer build and the AppImage check at start and every 6 hours while automatic updates are on; the other builds check when the settings window opens); npm and the official extension index on GitHub for the extension market, and GitHub for votes and comments; ModelScope, falling back to Hugging Face, when downloading the speech model. ## Data and uninstalling | System | Data folder | Uninstall | | --- | --- | --- | | Windows | `data` in the install folder; for the portable version, `data` in its folder | Settings → Apps; for the portable version, turn off **Start at login** under **Habits → General**, then delete the folder | | macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/Coopanion` | Drag Coopanion from Applications to the Trash | | Linux | `~/.config/Coopanion` | deb: `sudo apt remove coopanion`; AppImage: delete the file | Uninstalling the installed version keeps your data. The portable version keeps `data` inside its own folder, so back it up before deleting the folder. To remove everything, delete the data folder by hand; on Windows, delete the whole install folder and also `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Coopanion`, which records where the data is. Inside it, `home` holds memory, conversation history, settings and API keys, `home/models` the speech model, `extensions` the extensions and `logs` the logs. On Windows, after reinstalling into a new folder, the first start asks whether to keep using your earlier data or start a new Coo. ## FAQ
The pet is gone Right-click the tray icon and choose **Show pet**; if the tray icon is hidden, click `^` at the bottom right of the taskbar first. Opening the program again works too. On Mac, click the menu bar icon and choose **Show pet**.
Clicks go straight through Coo If the tray menu shows **Stop clicks passing through Coo**, select it to restore clicks. If this happens only while a Windows app is full screen on Coo’s display, turn off **Let clicks pass through Coo** under **Habits → Display → Full screen**. With the default click-through pause key enabled, hold Right Ctrl to click Coo temporarily.
Coo does not answer Check **Start → Connected model** and the run status at the bottom of the sidebar. If it says **Paused**, click resume. If it says **Not connected**, make sure the API key was pasted in full and the account has credit, then click **Save and start**; for an existing connection, **Test** checks it again. Keys for Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax and Zhipu GLM only work on the platform (mainland China or international) where they were created, and Doubao needs the default model enabled in the Ark console. After 5 failed model requests in a row, Coo tells you what went wrong in a bubble. For a rejected key or an unknown model name it offers a button that opens the settings; for rate limits and server errors it asks you to wait a while.
Coo cannot hear me - The mic button next to Coo should not be crossed out. - Tap Left Alt first, then press and hold it (two presses too far apart don't count). - The Voice input page should show the recognizer as ready (click **Download** if the model is missing; with **Send the transcript** off and only the recording going, a stopped recognizer is fine), and its level meter should move while you speak. - Windows: in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone, allow desktop apps to use the microphone. - Mac: in System Settings → Privacy & Security, turn on Microphone and Input Monitoring for Coopanion, then restart it.
I need a proxy Coopanion uses the system proxy (HTTP or HTTPS; SOCKS proxies are not used) as it is set at the moment of each request, so turning a proxy app on or off needs no restart, and a PAC script picks the proxy per site. If `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` are set in the environment Coopanion starts from, those take precedence. Local traffic inside the app skips the proxy.
On Linux, Coo leaves square trails behind it With Intel graphics (Mesa's iris driver), fast clear leaves old frames in transparent windows. Start Coopanion with `INTEL_DEBUG=nofc` set to turn it off, for example `INTEL_DEBUG=nofc coopanion` for the deb; rendering on a discrete GPU also fixes it.
The whole screen under the pet turns black On some Windows machines, transparent windows are drawn black while hardware acceleration is on. Try adding ` --disable-gpu-compositing` to the end of the shortcut's Target field.
What is it thinking? The Chat page has the full record. If something goes wrong, switch to advanced mode, click **Export diagnostics** on the Diagnostics page and attach the file to an [issue](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/issues).
## Community - QQ Group 5 (702451490) - QQ Group 6 (498403015) - Groups 1 (1080755910), 2 (1129285246), 3 (1132082279) and 4 (1080323271) are full. - [Discord](https://discord.gg/DR37WB5zJf) ## Contributing - Report bugs and ideas in [Issues](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/issues), with your OS version, Coopanion version and steps to reproduce. - To build from source or change the code, see the [development guide](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). ## Acknowledgements Thanks to everyone who has written code for Coopanion: And thanks to everyone who reports bugs and suggests ideas in Issues, the QQ groups and Discord. Coopanion is assembled from [Cortico](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Cortico): Cortico Core + Cormini Persona + the [desktop pet World](packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet), computer use included. ## Star history ## License [AGPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE), with an additional permission under section 7 to link the Steamworks API libraries that the Steam version loads. Releases up to and including 0.1.10 are MIT. The Cortico framework is MIT and ships as a submodule. Before opening a PR, read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md); your first contribution needs a signed [Contributor License Agreement](CLA.md). The DeepSeek Chan artwork (the textures under `packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet/web/whale/`) is not covered by the AGPL; its origin and the vendor logos are described in the [desktop pet World's third-party notices](packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Third-party components shipped or downloaded at runtime: Electron (MIT), Cortico (MIT), sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0), FunASR's SenseVoiceSmall model ([FunASR model license](https://github.com/modelscope/FunASR/blob/main/MODEL_LICENSE), downloaded when needed), OpenAI's Whisper small model (MIT, downloaded when needed), koffi (MIT), jpeg-js (BSD-3-Clause), pnpm (MIT), and on Windows MinGit from Git for Windows (GPL-2.0); model service logos come from [lobe-icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons) (MIT; each logo belongs to its company and only identifies the service).

官网 ｜ 安装 ｜ 快速上手 ｜ 日常使用 ｜ 费用与隐私 ｜ 常见问题 ｜ 社区 ｜ 更新记录 ｜ 参与开发

Coopanion 是一只住在屏幕底边的桌宠，名叫 Coo。它在底边走来走去，用气泡跟你聊天，按住说话键它就能听你说话；你同意的话，它还能看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘，帮你操作电脑。Windows、macOS 和 Linux 都能用。 界面有简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Français、Deutsch、Español (Latinoamérica)、Português (Brasil)、Italiano、Русский 11 种语言。第一次启动时跟随系统语言，系统语言不在其中就用英文，之后可以在「习惯」页的「语言」里改。Coo 也用界面语言跟你说话。除简体中文和英文外，译文由模型翻译，发现不通顺的地方欢迎提 PR。

## 功能 - 支持 DeepSeek、通义千问、Kimi、智谱 GLM、豆包、MiniMax、阶跃星辰、百度千帆、OpenRouter、OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、xAI，选一家，贴上 API Key 就能用。也可以登录 ChatGPT 账号，用你的 ChatGPT 套餐。 - 按住说话键说话，或者打字，Coo 在气泡里回你。语音默认在本机识别，也可以交给你配置的转写服务。 - Coo 会记住你。它对你的了解写在 `PARTNER.md`，更长的记忆按主题和日期整理。电脑上有 Git 时，Coo 改过的文字都留有历史版本；Windows 版自带 Git，macOS 和 Linux 用系统里装的 Git。 - 你允许后，Coo 可以看屏幕、点击、打字、切换窗口。这个功能默认关着，什么时候问你可以自己定；你一动鼠标或键盘它就先停手，按说话键开口能直接打断它。 - Coo 在想事情、看文件、搜索、写东西或操作电脑时，头顶会冒出对应的小图标。 - 形象可以选 Coo，或者 **DeepSeek 大肥鱼**（会动的鲸鱼娘，八套厂商配色，三套衣服）；别的形象包在「装扮」页导入，见[形象包兼容承诺](packages/cortico-world-desktop-pet/README.md#形象包兼容承诺)。 - Coo 有奶Coo、灯、杯、铸、心、冬等配色，头顶可以戴帽子、兽耳或光环，耳侧可以挂耳机、耳环或蝴蝶结，还有眼镜和颈饰。桌宠、气泡和字的大小分开调。 - 跟 Coo 说几点或者几分钟后提醒你，它会定好闹钟。 - 在「World 扩展 → 扩展市场」装 World，比如 QQ 机器人、画室和小游戏。 - 可以把 Coo 和气泡导出成 OBS 的「浏览器」来源，背景透明，直播时能叠在画面上。 每个版本改了什么，见 [Releases](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases)。 ## 安装 你需要： - Windows 10 或 11（x64）、Windows 11（Arm64）、macOS 13 及以上（Apple 芯片和 Intel 都行），或者 64 位 Linux 桌面（X11；Wayland 会话里经 XWayland 运行，有[Linux](#linux)一节写的限制；语音识别要 glibc 2.32 及以上，也就是 Ubuntu 22.04、Debian 12 及更新的版本）； - 一家模型服务的 API Key，按用量付费（见[费用与隐私](#费用与隐私)），或者一个开了套餐的 ChatGPT 账号。 每个版本的发布页都附有 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，可以用来核对下载的文件。 ### Windows - **安装包**：从[最新发布](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/releases/latest)下载 `Coopanion-Setup-版本号.exe` 并运行。Arm 处理器的电脑下载 `Coopanion-Setup-版本号-arm64.exe`。安装包没有数字签名，Windows 可能提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」，点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。默认装在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Coopanion`，程序和数据都在这个目录里。别装进 Program Files 这类要管理员权限的目录，Coopanion 在那里写不了数据，会提示后退出。从桌面快捷方式启动。如果安装后没有生成快捷方式，直接运行安装目录里的 `Coopanion.exe`。 - ## 日常使用 ### 说话与互动 - **说话**：快速按一下**左 Alt**（Mac 上是**左 Option**），紧接着按住说话，松开发送。说话键、麦克风、说话门槛和收音方式（按住说话键时收音、用说话键切换收音、持续收音）在「语音输入」页改。麦克风选系统默认时，你换了系统的默认输入设备，Coo 也跟着换。所选的麦克风拔掉或找不到时，Coo 改用系统默认输入设备，插回后再换回来。收音开着回声消除和降噪，不开自动增益，Coo 不会改动系统的麦克风音量；声音太小时，在系统设置里调高输入音量。 - **打字**时，可以在「对话」页输入，也可以点击 Coo 旁边的气泡按钮打开打字框。启用「习惯 → 打字键」后，在任何窗口都能打开打字框（默认连按两下左 Ctrl）。打字框每条消息最多 500 字、4 张图片，对话页每条最多 4000 字、8 张图片。超过字数上限时会保留草稿。如果草稿在 4000 字以内，点击「在对话页继续编辑」就能把打字框里的文字和图片一起带过去。 - **对话页**：往上翻到更早的消息后，输入框上方出现「↓ 回到底部」，点一下回到最新的消息。 - **换键**：说话键和打字键都可以改成别的键、组合键或鼠标侧键，按一到三下触发。两个设成同一个键时，快速双击打开打字框；最后一下按住超过 300 毫秒才开始收音，这时不会打开打字框。这 300 毫秒里说的话也会收进去；开了「按住时才打开麦克风」时，麦克风要到这时才打开，请等倾听气泡出现再说话。暂停穿透键默认是按住右 Ctrl。把它设成和说话键同一个键时（比如说话键「点一下左 Alt 再按住」、暂停穿透键「按住左 Alt」），点一下再按住只收音，直接按住只暂停穿透。暂停穿透键和说话键的按法完全相同时，「习惯」页会提示。 - **气泡**：把鼠标移进已显示的台词气泡，气泡会停留到鼠标移开；开局引导的气泡照常按时走完。点一下 Coo 说的话，这句话剩下的部分就跳过。Coo 请你确认时（比如操作电脑之前）会响一声提醒，在「习惯 → 音效」里取消勾选「提醒」就不再响。状态气泡、输入气泡、气泡和字的大小、出字速度在「习惯 → 气泡」调，旁边的「播放示例」按当前设置演示一遍对话。台词和输入气泡停留多久也在那里设置：「自动」，或「固定」1–60 秒，台词气泡从出完字、输入气泡从发出或识别完成时开始计时；台词后面排着提问或引导时，固定档按自动档的时长收起。 - **闹钟**：定好的闹钟在「应用通知」页的「闹钟」里能看到，也能删掉，删了 Coo 会知道。每天的闹钟遇到夏令时切换，仍按原来的当地时间响。应用关着时错过的闹钟，下次启动会补上。 - **节日**：圣诞节和 2027 年元旦当天，Coo 第一次出现在桌面上时会知道今天过节；Coo 已经在桌面上的话，零点时知道。知道是元旦时，Coo 可以在身后放一次写着「2027」的烟花。 - **互动**：点一下是戳它，在它头上来回划是摸头，按住拖动是把它拎起来。拖到一半松手能把它甩出去，拎到另一块屏幕上松手，它就留在那块屏幕上。哪些互动它会马上回应，在「习惯 → 回应模式」里选。 语音默认在本机识别：中、英、日、韩语用 FunASR，法、德、西、葡、意、俄语用 Whisper，Windows 上还可以用系统自带的识别。也可以在「语音输入」页改用 **OpenAI 兼容**的转写服务，这时每句录音都会发给那个服务。 当前的模型支持音频输入时（例如已启用多模态输入的 Gemini 或豆包连接），每批语音的录音会和识别出的文字一起发送给模型。「语音输入」页可以关闭「投递录音」，也可以关闭「投递转写」直接发送录音，不等待识别。识别服务可以单独停止，重启后保持停止；开着时，识别出的文字随后显示在 Coo 旁边的气泡和「对话」页上。录音超过「录音上限」（默认 5 分钟）或模型不支持音频输入时，在识别服务可用的情况下退回文字投递。 ### 桌宠菜单与鼠标穿透 鼠标停在 Coo 身上时会显示悬停按钮。打字、语音输入、走动、夜间模式、音效、隐藏、鼠标穿透、大小、透明度、装扮、电脑操作和「我的 World」都可以在引导或「习惯 → 行为与互动」里选择，最多 6 个。右键 Coo 可以使用同一组操作，也可以打开设置、暂停或继续运行、退出应用。 鼠标停在「装扮」上时，滚动滚轮或点击即可切换收藏的形象。停在「大小」或「透明度」上时，拖动滑条或在按钮上滚动滚轮就能调整。点击按钮可以固定滑条，再次点击或点击别处即可收起。调整大小或更换形象时，按钮会留在鼠标下方，直到鼠标移开。使用滑条或选择形象时，Coo 的台词和提问会等你操作完再出现，确认卡片会立即显示，思考气泡会等控件收起后再出现。 「习惯 → 显示」也能调整形象的透明度，范围是 0–95%。气泡和按钮保持原有透明度。Windows 用户还可以在同一页启用「全屏时 → 变淡」。前台窗口在 Coo 所在的显示器上进入全屏时，Coo 会使用这里的透明度（默认 40%）。 「电脑操作」按钮显示 Coo 能否操作电脑。在「习惯」里添加这个按钮或首次启用电脑操作时，会出现风险说明。确认后，点击按钮就能直接开关电脑操作。如果还没有确认，点击处于关闭状态的按钮会打开对应设置。 托盘菜单（Mac 上是菜单栏图标）可以显示或隐藏 Coo、切换鼠标穿透、重新启动或退出应用。关闭设置窗口后，Coo 会继续运行。开机启动在「习惯 → 通用」里设置。 启用鼠标穿透后，点击会落到 Coo 下方的窗口，Coo 照常走动和说话。悬停按钮和托盘菜单里的鼠标穿透开关只在本次运行有效。想临时点击 Coo，可以在「习惯 → 行为与互动」启用「暂停穿透键」，单独按住设定的键（默认右 Ctrl）。右键菜单、收藏形象的轮盘、固定的滑条、打字框、提问或确认卡片打开时，Coo 会继续接收点击。正在拖动时，松开鼠标后才恢复穿透。 ### 装扮与声音 在「装扮」页换形象、配色和配件，配件的主色和点缀色也能调，改了马上生效。形象包可以从 zip 或文件夹导入，也可以直接拖到页面上；导入的形象包也在这里卸载。导入、替换和卸载的确认、进度与错误统一显示在设置窗口弹窗中。形象下面的「大小」调整 Coo 在桌面上的大小；每个形象分别记住自己的大小，换回这个形象时恢复。「装扮」和「开始」页预览里的大小不变。 点预览右上角的星形按钮，把当前形象加到「已收藏的形象」，它们排成一行列在页面最上方：点一下换上，拖动调整顺序，也能重命名和删除。收藏会连同当时的大小一起保存，换上时也换回这个大小；收藏的缩略图按大小显示，角上标着百分比。选中一个收藏并做了改动（包括大小）后，星形按钮旁会出现保存按钮，把改动存回它。 也可以直接让 Coo 给自己换。默认它能自己改形象、配色、走动和打呼，改大小、音效、夜间模式、称呼这些会先问你；放宽或收紧在「习惯 → 自主配置权限」里调。问起 Coo 现在的样子时，Coo 能取一张那一刻桌面上的身体图片来回答，图里没有气泡和桌面；隐藏桌宠后取不到。

在「习惯 → 音效」里可以选要响的声音、调桌宠所有声音的音量，还可以让声音跟着 Coo 在屏幕上的位置偏左或偏右。打开「说话声 → 念出气泡文字」后，Coo 出字时会念出一串短音节，代替原来的说话音效，音高和语速都能调。这些设置只管桌宠的声音，其他 World 的声音在它们自己的页面里设置。

想在 OBS 里放 Coo：打开「习惯 → 其他 → 导出 OBS 画面」，把显示的地址加成 OBS 的「浏览器」来源，宽高填屏幕分辨率。画面里只有 Coo 和气泡，背景透明。 ### 让 Coo 操作电脑 这个功能默认关着。在「习惯 → 电脑操作」打开「让 Coo 操作这台电脑」，看完风险说明后确认。只想让它看屏幕、不碰鼠标键盘，就关掉「允许操作鼠标和键盘」。 什么时候问你，有四档可选： | 询问时机 | 什么时候问 | | --- | --- | | 每轮询问 | 每一轮第一次看屏幕或动鼠标键盘之前 | | 操作前询问 | 看屏幕不问；每一轮第一次动鼠标键盘之前问 | | 询问一次（默认） | 看屏幕不问；动手前问一次，同意后在有效期内不再问，有效期默认 30 分钟 | | 从不询问 | 都不问 | - 平时在气泡里问你，桌宠隐藏时改用系统对话框。 - Coo 在终端里打字或按 Win+R 之前，会另外问你一次，同意后同样在有效期内不再问。不想被问，可以在高级模式的「桌宠 → 配置」里关掉。 - 只有你在桌宠这边说的话、打的字和选的选项能让 Coo 动手。其他 World 发来的操作请求，它会先在气泡里问你。 - Coo 能按住键盘上的键最多 30 秒，按住期间不会因为你动鼠标键盘而停下；也能在几步之间一直按着鼠标键。这一轮结束时，它还按着的键都会松开。 - 你一动鼠标或键盘，Coo 就先停下，等你停手两秒（默认）再继续；你一直在用、等满 15 秒，它就放弃这一步。你给它打字时，它也会先等你打完。 - 用说话键说的话投递后就会打断 Coo：正在生成的回复和还没做的步骤都会停下，已经开始的点击、拖拽或一串按键会做完再停，按住的键会马上松开。收音方式是「持续收音」时，听到的话不会打断它。按下说话键时「念出气泡文字」的声音马上停止，松开之前出现的台词也不出声。 - 登录、输密码、付款这些步骤请自己来。一次唤醒默认最多请求模型 40 次，到上限它会停下，想继续就再跟它说一声；上限可以在高级模式里改「单次唤醒上限」。 ### 设置窗口 点托盘图标，或者右键 Coo 选设置，就能打开设置窗口。 | 页面 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 开始 | 连接模型、显示或隐藏桌宠、界面配色、重新走一遍引导 | | 习惯 | 语言和称呼、自动更新、使用统计、走动和回应、Coo 能自己改哪些设置、快捷键、显示（含动态效果）、声音、电脑操作、OBS 画面 | | 装扮 | 形象、配色和配件，导入或卸载形象包 | | 语音输入 | 识别引擎或转写服务、下载模型、说话键、麦克风、收音方式、说话门槛 | | 系统提示词 | 人设和提示词模板；Ctrl+S 保存，点「立即应用」后当前对话就用上新提示词 | | 用量与成本 | 按时间查看调用次数、token 用量和费用，可按调用用途、模型、模型连接或 World 查看明细 | | 对话 | 聊天记录、打字、图片 | | World 扩展 | 已装的 World、分组和排序，扩展市场 | 「用量与成本」的「按 World」明细会按来源分摊一次请求的 token 和费用，参与这次请求的每个 World 都计一次调用。没有 World 来源的用量列在「未归属」。 「习惯 → 显示」里的「动态效果」管设置窗口和桌宠的界面动画，三档一起作用于两边：高全部保留；中去掉回弹和装饰性的小动作，列表换位改为淡入淡出；低只留颜色变化和表示「正在进行」的指示（转圈、进度条、思考点），其余直接到位。默认跟随系统的「减少动态效果」：系统要求减少时为低，否则为高。Coo 自己的走动不受它影响。 侧栏底部可以暂停和继续运行，也能切到「高级模式」。高级模式多出「模型供应商」、Persona、Memory、「控制台」和「运行诊断」几页。在「模型供应商」里可以换模型、调推理强度、接入其他兼容的服务、给没有内置价目的服务填价目，也可以装供应商扩展。 设置中的操作错误显示在发起操作的控件旁；控件已离开可视区域时使用底部通知。读取失败留在对应内容区域；刷新失败保留已有数据和编辑内容，重试成功后清除错误。运行诊断分别显示连接、事件和日志错误。头像和名称保存、暂停运行、删除闹钟成功时，由更新后的界面体现结果。 ### World 扩展 在「World 扩展 → 扩展市场」里可以搜索 World，按类别或标签筛选，点卡片上的「添加到我的 World」安装，也可以先点开详情看看。收录在[官方索引](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/cortico-extensions)里的扩展还有标签、投票和评论，评论要登录 GitHub。注意事项标签可以排除，排除后带这个标签的扩展不再出现，下次打开也还记得。 装好的扩展会先出现在「待生效」里，点「重启进程」后生效。在「我的 World」里，你可以： - 给 World 分组、拖动排序，侧栏也按这个顺序排； - 点名字或头像看扩展详情，进入它的配置； - 把 World 从侧栏藏起来，或者让它照常运行、但不让 Coo 看到它的工具和消息，也可以停用、单独重启或删除它。 在 World 设置页，点击标题旁带圆圈的 **i** 即可打开扩展详情。 运行中的 World 不能删除，要先停用。删除的 World 会标红留在「待生效」里，重启进程后才消失。

供应商扩展在「高级模式 → 模型供应商 → 扩展市场」里，还有连接在用的不能删除，要先删掉这些连接。装的扩展都放在数据目录中，重装应用后还在。 安装或卸载扩展时退出应用，会等这次安装或卸载做完再退出。 ### 更新 Windows 安装版和 AppImage 会在后台下载新版本，下好后 Coo 会问你要不要重启更新；选「下次再说」，就等你退出应用时再装。不想自动更新，可以关掉「习惯 → 通用 → 自动更新」，之后不再检查和下载，已经下好的更新也不会装。 Windows 安装器会先校验新版文件，再替换当前版本。安装中断后，在原目录重新运行完整安装包即可恢复。安装错误记录在 `data\logs\installer.log`。选择「下次再说」后，如果退出时更新失败，Coopanion 会在下次启动时显示失败的版本和日志位置。 Mac 版、deb 和 Windows 便携版不会自动更新。有新版本时，设置窗口的标题栏会出现下载链接，下载后自己安装。 ## 费用与隐私 - **费用**：Coopanion 免费。聊天的费用由你选的模型服务按用量收取，在「用量与成本」页能看到。DeepSeek、OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 付费档和 xAI 有内置价目，金额可以按实时汇率换算成别的币种（取不到汇率时用内置汇率）。登录 ChatGPT 时用的是套餐额度，不显示费用。 - **模型请求**会把你的消息、附带的图片、你与 Coo 的互动，以及操作电脑时的截图发给你配置的模型服务。启用多模态输入后，Coo Pet Provider 每次请求都会附上当前上下文中模型支持的附件，包括之前的截图和录音。如果服务拒收附件，扩展会去掉这次的附件重试一次。 - **本地数据**包括 API Key、ChatGPT 登录状态、记忆、聊天记录、设置和日志。语音默认在本机识别。选择转写服务后，每句话的录音都会发给该服务。启用「语音输入 → 投递录音」且模型支持音频输入时，随消息发送的录音也会保存在本机数据目录里。 - **匿名使用统计**：发到 `survey.palailab.org`，内容是版本号、系统和硬件概况、用的哪家模型、装了哪些扩展、使用次数和时长、设置、程序崩溃时出错的位置，以及一个随机生成的安装编号；不含对话、截图、Key、错误消息和你的文件。每个字段见 [docs/TELEMETRY.md](docs/TELEMETRY.md)。在「习惯 → 通用 → 使用统计」里可以关掉。 - **其他联网**：向 GitHub 查询新版本（Windows 安装版和 AppImage 在启动时和之后每 6 小时查一次，关掉自动更新就不查；其他版本在打开设置窗口时查）；扩展市场访问 npm 和 GitHub 上的官方扩展索引，投票和评论要访问 GitHub；下载语音模型时访问 ModelScope，失败了改用 Hugging Face。 ## 数据与卸载 | 系统 | 数据位置 | 卸载 | | --- | --- | --- | | Windows | 安装目录下的 `data`；便携版是它所在文件夹的 `data` | 在「设置 → 应用」里卸载；便携版先关掉「习惯 → 通用」里的开机启动，再删文件夹 | | macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/Coopanion` | 把「应用程序」里的 Coopanion 拖进废纸篓 | | Linux | `~/.config/Coopanion` | deb：`sudo apt remove coopanion`；AppImage：删掉文件 | 卸载安装版不会删数据。便携版的 `data` 就在它的文件夹里，删文件夹前记得备份。确定不要了，就手动删掉数据目录；Windows 上删整个安装目录，再删掉记录数据位置的 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Coopanion`。数据目录里，`home` 放记忆、聊天记录、设置和 API Key，`home/models` 放语音模型，`extensions` 放扩展，`logs` 放日志。 在 Windows 上重装到新目录后，第一次启动会问你：接着用之前的数据，还是新建一只。 ## 常见问题
桌宠不见了 右键托盘图标，选「显示桌宠」；托盘图标被收起来时，先点任务栏右下角的 `^`。再打开一次程序也行。Mac 上点菜单栏图标，选「显示桌宠」。
点不到 Coo，点击直接穿过了它 如果托盘菜单里显示「停用鼠标穿透」，选择它即可恢复点击。如果只有 Windows 应用在 Coo 所在的屏幕上全屏时才会穿透，关闭「习惯 → 显示 → 全屏时」里的「鼠标穿透」。启用了默认的「暂停穿透键」后，也可以按住右 Ctrl 临时点击 Coo。
Coo 不说话 / 没反应 先看「开始 → 已连接的模型」和侧栏底部的运行状态。显示**已暂停**，点「继续运行」。显示**暂未连接**，检查 API Key 有没有贴全、账户有没有余额，再点「保存并开始」；已经连上的可以点「测试连接」再查一次。通义千问、Kimi、智谱 GLM、MiniMax 的 Key 只能在申请它的平台（国内或国际）上用；豆包要先在方舟控制台开通默认模型。 模型请求连续失败 5 次后，Coo 会在气泡里告诉你出了什么错。Key 被拒或者模型名不对时，气泡上有打开设置的按钮；被限流或服务出错时，它会让你等一会儿再试。
它听不到我说话 - Coo 旁边的麦克风按钮没有被划掉； - 先快速按一下左 Alt，再按住（两下隔得太久不算）； - 「语音输入」页显示识别服务已就绪（提示模型没下载就点「下载」；关了「投递转写」只发录音时，识别服务停着也可以），说话时电平条在跳； - Windows：在「设置 → 隐私和安全性 → 麦克风」里允许桌面应用使用麦克风； - Mac：在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」里给 Coopanion 打开「麦克风」和「输入监控」，改完重启 Coopanion。
需要走代理 Coopanion 用系统代理（HTTP 或 HTTPS 代理，SOCKS 代理不生效），每次请求都按当时的系统设置走，所以开关代理软件不用重启 Coopanion，PAC 脚本也会按网站分别生效。启动 Coopanion 的环境里设了 `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` 时，以环境变量为准。本机内部的通信不走代理。
Linux 上 Coo 走过的地方留下方块残影 用 Intel 核显（Mesa 的 iris 驱动）时，快速清屏会在透明窗口里留下旧画面。启动时设置环境变量 `INTEL_DEBUG=nofc` 把它关掉，比如 deb 版运行 `INTEL_DEBUG=nofc coopanion`；有独立显卡的话，改用独显渲染也能解决。
桌宠所在的屏幕整块变黑 有些 Windows 电脑开着硬件加速时，透明窗口会画成黑色。可以在快捷方式「目标」一栏的末尾加上 ` --disable-gpu-compositing` 试试。
想看它在想什么 「对话」页有完整记录。遇到问题时，打开高级模式，在「运行诊断」页点「导出诊断」，把诊断包附在 [Issue](https://github.com/Pal-AI-Lab/Coopanion/issues) 里。
